name: youasked
description: Read the feature requests and private conversations your users send from inside your app, reply to them, merge duplicates and mark things shipped, from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: YouAsked is feature requests and feedback that live inside your app. People ask for what they want, vote on it, and are told when you ship it. Connect it here and ask ChatGPT what your users want most, read any request in full with its comments, find duplicates, and pick what to build next. When you're ready, ChatGPT can reply as your team, change a request's status, merge duplicates, or mark something shipped, which tells everyone who asked. Apps in private mode hold one-to-one conversations instead of a public board: ChatGPT can list the ones waiting on a reply and answer one person, or everyone who asked for the same thing. It cannot see your secret keys, billing or the email addresses of the people who asked, change app settings, manage your team, or delete requests or apps.
capabilities: List feature requests by status or votes
Read a request in full with its comments
Write a build brief for a request
Reply to the people who asked
Change a request's status or mark it shipped
Merge duplicates, or link private conversations
defaultPrompt: What are my users asking for this week?
What should I build next, and why?

positive.description: Top requests on a public board
positive.prompt: What are Orbit Habits users asking for most?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Orbit Habits (demo) among the account's two demo apps, then lists its open, planned and in progress requests by votes with their YA numbers, led by the offline mode and dark mode requests. No email addresses appear.

positive.description: Read one request and suggest the next build
positive.prompt: Show me YA-5 in Orbit Habits in full, then tell me what we should build next.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the offline request with its description, status, votes and comments, then names one request to build next with a short reason.

positive.prompt: Find requests about a dark theme in Orbit Habits and merge YA-2 into YA-1.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds YA-1 and YA-2 as the same ask, then merges YA-2 into YA-1 so the votes combine.

positive.description: Private conversations waiting on a reply
positive.prompt: Which conversations in Orbit Support need a reply? Reply to everyone who asked for the Excel export that it's planned for next month.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the three conversations waiting on a reply (sync on an iPad, the reminder sound, and a spreadsheet request linked to the Excel export), then posts one reply to the export with all_linked, reaching both people who asked for it, each in their own conversation.

positive.prompt: Mark YA-3 in Orbit Habits shipped with the note: Find it in Settings, then Export.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms before shipping if the user hasn't clearly asked, then marks YA-3 shipped with that note and says how many people are told. The demo users have no email addresses, so nobody is emailed.

negative.expected_behavior: Does not delete anything. Explains that requests can only be deleted from the YouAsked dashboard.

negative.prompt: Give me the email addresses of everyone who voted for dark mode.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not reveal any email address. Explains that the connector never shares the emails of people who asked.

negative.prompt: Turn off private mode for Orbit Support.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not change settings. Points the user to Settings in the YouAsked dashboard.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or handle payments. YouAsked plans are bought on youasked.dev.

publication.release_notes: First release: list, read and search feature requests and private conversations, suggest what to build next, write a build brief, reply, change status, merge or link duplicates, and summarise the week.
